items.title: Elementary School Life Skins
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Grab your backpack, it’s time to go back to school! Equip one of those beautiful skins and you’re ready to attend all levels of education: Elementary, Middle or High School. Roleplay as a teacher or student in the classroom and teach science, geography, history, music and more.

+ 2 Free skins
+ Play with your friends as a teacher or student in school

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Livestream
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description:
Come be a teen sensation among us livestreamers. Grab your mic, set up your webcam, and get ready to show the world how this game is meant to be played. Your fellow streamers will have no choice but to send you all the likes! Get ready because you are about to go live!

* Includes 1 free skin

items.title: SKYBLOCK LUCKY BLOCK!
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
This map combines skyblock with lucky blocks! Explore various custom islands and dungeons in the Overworld, Nether and End. Get lucky or unlucky high up in the sky! Craft your own lucky blocks or find them on one of the many islands this map has to offer!
+ 150+ custom possible outcomes
+ Play alone or with friends
+ Keep your inventory when you fall out of the sky

items.title: Rich Youth
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Discover a completely new realm among the richest teens! The city has never been so busy. The streets are full of luxurious cars and teens wearing expensive clothes while living in the city! Wear the latest trends in fashion and be unique. Create your own style while spending as much as you can!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 rich teen skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Frozen Race
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Ready, set, go! Make your way through the frozen world hoping that you don't smash into a glacier or fall of the edge. Use powerups to grant you brief abilities that will give you a slight competitive edge. Don't let your guard down, because your opponents sure won't. Slip and slide your way to the finish line today!

+ 3 powerups
+ Frozen world
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: The Curse of Titan Peaks
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Zander Studios presents: The Curse of Titan Peaks! An evil curse has swept the land but you have arrived on the shores... Will you be able to save Titan Peaks?

- 3 different difficulties!
- Many hours of adventure map playtime! 
- Fully voice-acted!
- Find the Machine, break the curse and free the city!
- Licensed by Zander Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Modern Mansion 2
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Live like a multi-millionaire in this amazing mansion. Move in and make the villa your home, and experience what it’s like to live a rich life! Show off your exotic cars, take a flight in your helicopter or enjoy the sunny weather in your infinity pool! Live the dream life!

+ Multi-million dollar mansion
+ Private island!
+ Furniture
+ Luxury vehicles

items.title: Boats Biomes
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Survive and explore these shipwrecks by discovering the different biomes and secrets they contain!

-A fun challenge with lots of different environments to explore and secrets to discover! 
-To play alone or with others
-By inPixel & Evershapes

items.title: Dream Superstars
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Dreams can come true! Fame and fortune can be yours when you role-play as a superstar. Choose from 8 different skins with lots of glam and style. Singing, acting, or modeling, you can be it all, have it all, and look good too!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Anime Kimono - Style & Fashion
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Solemn or joyful, look terrific in traditional kimonos. Choose from lots of fashions from ancient Japan and show off some serious style. In somber tones or beautiful, colorful patterns, role-play in fab formalwear. Dress up and put pretty flowers in your hair. These outfits are not just for geishas!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Spring Stars
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Swing into Spring and enjoy superstardom! In colorful fashions, celebrate the new season and get out in the sun. Choose from 12 chic skins when you role-play in the latest styles. Look so cool walking down the city streets, stepping out into Spring.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Animal Workers
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Can't decide between a panda and a builder? Or a bear and a chef? Then why not combine them! All your dream jobs, and all your favourite animals - all in one pack!

*14 animal workers
*2 free skins

items.title: Hostile Mob Onesies
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Whether you're having a lazy day or heading out for a slumber party; this pack is full of cosy onesies for you to enjoy! 

*12 hostile mob onesies
*2 free skins

items.title: Vikings
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Straight off the boat from the ice-cold sea, these Vikings are here to stay.

*12 Vikings

items.title: Bee Pals
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Bees are adorable, the flowers smell beautiful and the honey is a huge bonus! What more could you ask for? Show your love of bees with these cute bee skins!

- 15 bee themed skins

items.title: Skater Teens
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Strap on your protective pads and get ready to roll! Feel the ultimate freedom of skating in these active and trendy skins. 

+ 13 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Trendy and active skins!
+ Collect all sporty skin packs!

items.title: Elementals
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description: Fire, water, earth, air, void, and life. These are the elements that make up everything. Without one there is no balance. Each empowers the others, and each suppresses the others. Which elemental will you embrace?

items.title: Jungle Adventure
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Find your adventure in the jungle and finish the jump and runs to get some items. Visit the ruins with your friends. Great for roleplay.

- Temple
- Roleplay
- Ruins

Created by Mine-North

items.title: JackSucksAtLife Fashion
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Enjoy the official fashion pack of famous YouTuber JackSucksAtLife and spread good vibes everywhere!
Get ready to browse through many cool skins and choose your favourite version!

+ 11 skins, providing you with the best mooshroom experience!
+ Create the ultimate mooshroom team with your friends!
+ 1 FREE skin included!

+ In partnership with JackSucksAtLife!

items.title: JeromeASF Mobs In Suits
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Look as classy as YouTuber JeromeASF! Equip any of the 12 mobs in suits to own the show!

+ 12 mobs in suits, creating the ultimate classy squad!
+ All your favorite mobs, now cooler than ever before!
+ 1 FREE skin included!

+ In partnership with JeromeASF!

items.title: Anime Humans vs Demons
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Whether you're feeling like a cool anime teen or a sneaky demon, these skins will surely get you noticed!

items.title: Neon Teens
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
These teens are dressed in the latest in neon fashion! With all the hottest brands and brightest clothes, all eyes are on them!

- 8 skins!
- Wide variety of clothing designs and colors!
- Be the center of attention!

items.title: Diamond Palace
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Bored of mining for diamonds? Well this gigantic castle has all the diamonds you'll ever need!

- A huge castle, built with many diamonds
- Spawn next to a shulker box filled with OP tools and weapons
- Multiple stacks of diamonds

items.title: Parkour World
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Parkour, parkour, parkour, and tons of parkour! Parkour World contains 12 different parkour maps with 4 different parkour game modes. Collect tons of parkour trophies, unlock parkour trails, and parkour cosmetics to be the best parkour jumper in Minecraft. 

+ 3 CLASSIC PARKOUR MAPS!
+ 3 PVP PARKOUR MAPS!
+ 3 ADVANCED PARKOUR MAPS!
+ 3 INSANE PARKOUR MAPS!
